strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the prevailing trend using a fair value gap that caused a break of structure. Identify the three-candle imbalance, prefer the FVG close to the order block, then wait for price to retrace back into that FVG and enter on the tap/retest for continuation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above the FVG for sells. No concrete profit-target rule is given; management is to hold for continuation in the expected direction.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to tap back into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that happens, price may most likely leave out the order block and just tap into the fair value gap and start pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

canonical.enumeration_note: Enumerated as one strategy with bullish and bearish directional variants; the video teaches the same FVG retest continuation skeleton and gives a concrete stop rule but no explicit profit-target mechanic.
